description: Stop every container service of the site; the site serves its static files again. Volumes (database data) are kept unless deleteData is true, which deletes them for good. Use remove_app to stop only the containers; use delete_site to remove the whole site.

deleteData.description: Also delete every volume (database files) and generated secret. Irreversible. Default false.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: remove_app
title: Stop all container services of a site
